gaps.sentence: While the sets ___ (build), the actors rehearsed in a warehouse.
gaps.hint: two past actions, one passive and ongoing
gaps.explanation: Past continuous passive (were being built) for the longer background action.

gaps.sentence: The message ___ have been misheard by the interpreter.
gaps.explanation: Perfect modal passive = modal + have been + past participle: must have been misheard.

gaps.sentence: He refuses ___ (tell) what to do by people he's never met.
gaps.explanation: 'Refuse' takes a to-infinitive; passive meaning needs to be + told.

gaps.sentence: The experiments ___ (conduct) under strict laboratory conditions last year.
gaps.explanation: 'Last year' fixes past simple passive: were + conducted for the plural subject.

gaps.sentence: The house looked deserted; it ___ (empty) years earlier.
gaps.hint: past event before another past point
gaps.explanation: 'Years earlier' is before the past reference point, so past perfect passive: had been + emptied.

gaps.sentence: This form ___ (sign) in ink — digital signatures aren't valid.
gaps.explanation: Modal passive: modal + be + past participle. Obligation: must (also has to) be signed.

gaps.sentence: Guests ___ to arrive no later than seven.
gaps.explanation: Guests receive the request: present simple passive are + asked.

gaps.sentence: Your name ___ (find) anywhere on the guest list, I'm afraid.
gaps.explanation: Modal passive of ability/possibility: cannot be + past participle.
